# Firm Foundation Property Services

> Family-run land clearing and excavation in Mount Pleasant, South Carolina,
> serving the greater Charleston area: lot and underbrush clearing, tree and
> stump removal, grading and site prep, pool and pond excavation, and drainage.
> Smaller hardscape, landscaping and custom projects are taken on by request.

Owner: Josiah Lammers
Phone: (843) 998-5593
Email: josiahlammers1@gmail.com
Based in: Mount Pleasant, SC 29464
Service area: Mount Pleasant, Charleston, Daniel Island, Isle of Palms,
Sullivan's Island, West Ashley, James Island, Johns Island, Folly Beach
Quotes: free and on-site

## Pages

- [Home](https://firmfoundationsc.com/): land clearing and excavation overview, how a job runs, reviews, service area
- [Services](https://firmfoundationsc.com/services): all services, plus FAQs
- [Land Clearing](https://firmfoundationsc.com/services/land-clearing): lot, underbrush and selective clearing; Mount Pleasant clearing and marsh-buffer rules
- [Tree & Stump Removal](https://firmfoundationsc.com/services/tree-removal): removal, stump grinding or root-ball removal; tree permit rules by town
- [Excavation & Grading](https://firmfoundationsc.com/services/excavation): site prep, pads, driveways, regrading, SC811
- [Pool & Pond Excavation](https://firmfoundationsc.com/services/pools-and-ponds): pool digs with the pool builder, ponds dug to groundwater
- [Drainage](https://firmfoundationsc.com/services/drainage): French drains, swales, ditches and culverts
- [Our Work](https://firmfoundationsc.com/gallery): photos of completed projects
- [About](https://firmfoundationsc.com/about): family history and how the company works
- [Reviews](https://firmfoundationsc.com/reviews): verified Google reviews
- [Contact](https://firmfoundationsc.com/contact): free quote request form (job type, size, what's on the lot, timeline)

## Guides

Straight answers to the questions people ask before they call, with the local rules and the sources behind them.

- [Do I need a permit to remove a tree in Mount Pleasant?](https://firmfoundationsc.com/guides/mount-pleasant-tree-permit): protected sizes, exempt species, the $50 request, and who gets fined
- [What does it take to clear a lot in Mount Pleasant?](https://firmfoundationsc.com/guides/clearing-a-lot-in-mount-pleasant): permits, the marsh buffer, wet ground, burning and debris
- [Why does my yard flood after it rains, and how do you fix it?](https://firmfoundationsc.com/guides/yard-floods-after-rain): grade, slope away from the house, French drains, and draining onto neighbors
- [Who digs the hole for an in-ground pool?](https://firmfoundationsc.com/guides/who-digs-a-pool): who does what, how much dirt comes out, access and groundwater
- [Should a stump be ground down or pulled out?](https://firmfoundationsc.com/guides/stump-grinding-vs-removal): what grinding leaves behind, and when the root ball has to come out
